### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/spec`, touching **5** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **2** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/api-surface/ui.json`, `packages/spec/export-origins/ui.json`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**1** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/data-modeling/analytics.mdx`  _(via ReportSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_

⛔ **1** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-7.mdx`  _(via ReportSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **2** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/api-surface/ui.json`, `packages/spec/export-origins/ui.json`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- the SDK route bridge reached **60** of **212** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **168** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 630b4078daf45d41c2d0c19ece48661163dc6418` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `faf8b9f6fbd29880bc2d2b098a2e1a457f24e08a` — the merge of head `1707dd00edb420d45edcb08d6c842a5b9aa437a0` into base `630b4078daf45d41c2d0c19ece48661163dc6418`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin faf8b9f6fbd29880bc2d2b098a2e1a457f24e08a && git checkout faf8b9f6fbd29880bc2d2b098a2e1a457f24e08a
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 630b4078daf45d41c2d0c19ece48661163dc6418 1707dd00edb420d45edcb08d6c842a5b9aa437a0 && git checkout -B drift-repro 630b4078daf45d41c2d0c19ece48661163dc6418 && git merge --no-ff 1707dd00edb420d45edcb08d6c842a5b9aa437a0

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 630b4078daf45d41c2d0c19ece48661163dc6418
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 630b4078daf45d41c2d0c19ece48661163dc6418` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `1707dd00edb420d45edcb08d6c842a5b9aa437a0`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/ui/report.zod.ts (`checkReportChartSeriesSplit`, wired into `ReportSchema`'s non-joined superRefine arm; `seriesBy` docblock + describe), packages/spec/src/ui/dashboard.zod.ts (`SINGLE_SERIES_CHART_TYPES` const → export, docblock), packages/spec/src/ui/report.test.ts (new describe, 7 cases), generated api-surface/ui.json + export-origins/ui.json, content/docs/references/ui/report.mdx, .changeset/28424-report-chart-series-split.md. 7 files, +158/−9. Fixes #28424 (dispatch claim 6544971272, dev report 6545877106).
Inputs: card #28424 body + claim + dev report, the PR body, the PR diff at this head, `git show`/`git grep` on `origin/main` at the merge-base `5da3a8ce` (no main commit since touches any of the 7 files), hotcrm checkout; check-runs (read 2026-10-31T16:38Z: all 50 latest-per-name check-runs completed, 39 success + 11 skipped, none failed, none running) — 50 checks. No build or test run here; the seat's numbers (spec 773 files / 22837 tests, lint 80/80, dogfood 361+3, ablation per arm, 104 derived gates) are taken from the dev report and not re-measured.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Acceptance set narrows, as declared.** `ReportSchema` now refuses two value combinations that parsed at the base: `chart.seriesBy` present on a `chart.type` in `SINGLE_SERIES_CHART_TYPES` (`pie`/`donut`/`funnel`/`treemap`/`sankey`, verified on main dashboard.zod.ts L808-814), and `chart.seriesBy === chart.xAxis`. Both arms sit inside the existing `else` (non-joined) branch beside `checkReportOrder`, so a `joined` report keeps its one whole-`chart` refusal at `chart` and never reaches the new check (test "a joined report is untouched" pins it). `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` and `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` on the PR body and the changeset are right. The changeset is `@objectstack/spec: minor` with `feat(spec)!:` and an ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` marker; the marker's reason holds — no key moves, and a conversion cannot pick between "change the type" and "drop the split", so the refusal text names both fixes.
- **Public face: one new export.** `SINGLE_SERIES_CHART_TYPES` goes from module-private to exported through `export * from './dashboard.zod'` (ui/index.ts L41); api-surface and export-origins carry the one new row each and nothing else moves. `ReportChartSchema` stays an unrefined `ChartConfigSchema.extend(...)`, so its `.shape`/`.extend` readers (`SpecReportChartSchema` in ui/packages/types, chart.test.ts) are untouched — correct placement for a cross-field rule that needs `r.name` and the `chart.seriesBy` path.
- **One source holds inside the spec package.** report.zod.ts imports the constant for both the check and the `.describe()` text; no second list is added. For the record: `ui/packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DatasetWidget.tsx` L507 already carries its own `SINGLE_SERIES_CHART_FAMILIES` set with the same five members — pre-existing, not this PR's, and the renderer keeps its refusal panel as the last line of defence by the card's out-of-scope line.
- **Refusal texts are actionable and exclusive.** The single-series arm `return`s before the same-dimension arm, so a `pie` split by its own `xAxis` gets one issue, not two; it names the report, the type, the split, and prescribes `bar`/`column`/`horizontal-bar` or dropping `seriesBy`. The same-dimension arm says the split must name a different dimension than `xAxis` or be dropped.
- **Existing metadata: zero hits.** `git grep seriesBy` on main over examples/**, packages/qa/**, ui/** non-test metadata and the hotcrm checkout returns no authored `seriesBy` outside tests, so no shipped report is refused by this narrowing (the seat's reading, confirmed here).
- **Rider S1 superseded.** The `seriesBy === xAxis` lint warning named on #28206 is answered by this spec refusal; `validateChartBindings` (packages/lint) still owns whether `seriesBy` names a declared dimension, which the schema cannot see. The PR adds no lint rule — consistent with the card's "the dispatch decides which".

### ② Rulings cited

- Card #28424 scope (triage, from ui seat 2's #28206 landing note 6544899074): single-series arm in the spec with the dashboard's one set; same-dimension arm in spec or lint, dispatch's choice → spec, taken here. Dashboard precedent objectui#8894 ruling D (`checkDashboardWidgetChartMeasureArity`). No open ruling; Tier S (spec narrowing, seat lands after this record).

### ③ Narrowing / widening

- Narrowing only, declared. No key added, removed or renamed; `treemap`/`sankey` fall under the arm by set membership even though only pie/donut/funnel are enumerated in tests — the "one source" test covers every `ChartTypeSchema` member, so the refused set is pinned to the constant, not to three names.

### ④ Behaviour / flags

- Authoring-time only; the renderer's one-series refusal panel is unchanged. Studio's client-side `.shape` mirror still accepts both shapes until save/publish (PR acceptance note) — same position as the dashboard arm, noted not filed.
- Docs: `content/docs/references/ui/report.mdx` is regenerated describe text only; skills prose for `seriesBy` is #28207, out of scope.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 报表图表声明 `seriesBy`（按第二个维度拆成多条系列）时，有两种写法现在在编写阶段就被拒绝：一是图表类型是单系列类型（`pie` / `donut` / `funnel` / `treemap` / `sankey`），二是 `seriesBy` 和 `xAxis` 写成了同一个维度。拒绝信息会告诉作者怎么改：换成柱状类图表，或者去掉 `seriesBy`。
- **为什么改：** #28424。这两种写法以前都能通过校验，页面上却只画出一个报错框，或者每条系列只有一个点。用户打开报表才发现，作者在 `os build` 或 Studio 保存时什么都看不到。
- **风险与回滚：** 这是收窄。仓库里没有现有元数据用到这两种写法（开发已测，`seriesBy` 今天才合入）。单系列类型清单和仪表盘共用一份（`SINGLE_SERIES_CHART_TYPES`，只是改为导出）。回滚即 revert。
- **先看：** `packages/spec/src/ui/report.zod.ts` 中的 `checkReportChartSeriesSplit`。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/ui/report.test.ts`。
- **需要你做的：** 无。不属于受管面，契约复审已 PASS（6546191274），由席位落地。
- **席位意见：** ACCEPT，可落地。
